Here are some triples describing photosynthesis:

Plants (perform, photosynthesis)
Chloroplasts (contain, chlorophyll)
Chlorophyll (absorbs, light)
Light (provides, energy)
Leaves (capture, sunlight)
Stomata (allow, gas exchange)
Carbon dioxide (enters, leaves)
Water (is absorbed, by roots)
Chloroplasts (convert, light energy)
Energy (is transformed, to chemical energy)
Glucose (is produced, during process)
Oxygen (is released, as byproduct)
Mitochondria (use, glucose)
Cells (generate, ATP)
Photosynthesis (occurs, in chloroplasts)
Light reactions (split, water molecules)
Water molecules (release, electrons)
Electrons (create, electron transport chain)
Transport chain (generates, ATP)
Calvin cycle (fixes, carbon dioxide)
Enzymes (catalyze, chemical reactions)
Rubisco (captures, carbon dioxide)
Sugars (are synthesized, in stroma)
Plants (store, glucose)
Glucose (provides, energy for growth)

Would you like me to elaborate on any of these triples?
